description:
In a hyper-competitive society, where the gap between rich and poor is widening,a flawless existence are demanded, and only the strongest survive. Struggling and writhing amidst it all, can they reclaim what they've lost...?

Those who possess talent, yet have been pushed aside because of past mistakes or the circumstances they were born into. For them, a new beginning is offered — a hidden street basketball league known as ZERO RISE.

Only those who fight their way to victory can erase their past scars and reclaim the stage. Not only trained basketball players can step into this fight. Risking it all and pushing themselves to the limit, every kind of underdog gathers.

As they fight to RISE up from ZERO.

(Source: ZERO RISE English site)
